explanation: Matches Conjecture 1.3 of Badea–Grivaux (arXiv 2303.01089), the ×p,×q conjecture: the only continuous Borel probability measure on T invariant under both T_p and T_q is Lebesgue. 'Continuous' means no atom in the paper; `IsAtomLess` says no measurable set is a measure-theoretic atom, which for a Borel measure on the circle is equivalent to having no point masses. `MultiplicativelyIndependent` is log p / log q irrational, as in the paper. `volume` on `UnitAddCircle` is the normalised Haar measure. Faithful.
